facts.business: Fredun Pharmaceuticals Ltd. operates an integrated healthcare ecosystem spanning pharmaceuticals (generics, exports, institutional and OEM), nutraceuticals and wellness, veterinary care (Freossi, One Pet Stop, Wagr Retail), cosmeceuticals & personal care (BeautyFred), and mobility, rehabilitation & home healthcare (Chuu Balm, BraceOn, NebOn, DigiOn).

segments.name: Veterinary Healthcare (Freossi, One Pet Stop, Wagr Retail)

capacity_or_capex.item: Industrial plot acquisition in Palghar, Maharashtra (~76,000 sq. ft.)
Commissioning of specialised functional foods manufacturing facility

guidance_or_targets.statement: Management believes the increasing consumer focus on preventive healthcare and wellness will continue to support strong growth prospects for this business over the next five to six years.

auditor.name: M/s. R.H. Nisar & Co. (Chartered Accountant)
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: There are no qualifications, reservations or adverse remarks or disclaimers made in their Report dated May 26, 2026 on the Financial Statements of the Company for Financial Year 2025-26.

key_risks: Revenue recognition risk due to volume of transactions, sales cut-off, contractual terms, and judgments involved in accounting for sales returns and other adjustments
Capital expenditure capitalization risk due to judgment in determining nature of expenditure, timing of capitalization and readiness of assets for intended use
facts.related_party_note: The Company has granted unsecured loans to its subsidiary and step-down subsidiary. The loans are non-interest bearing and repayable on demand without any specified repayment terms.
